source_note: Clause identifiers, requirement families and titles reflect the published structure of PCI DSS v4.0.1. The `requirement_text` values are firm-authored summaries, NOT the PCI Security Standards Council's copyrighted text. See ADR-010: replace this file with a licensed full-text export and re-run the loader under a new corpus_version before processing real client evidence.

families.1: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
families.2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
families.4: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission Over Open, Public Networks
families.5: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
families.6: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
families.7: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
families.8: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
families.9: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
families.10: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
families.11: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
families.12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: All security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 1 are documented, kept current, in use, and known to all affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 1 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles and responsibilities for performing network security control activities are documented, assigned, and understood by the assigned personnel.

requirements.name: Configuration standards for network security control rulesets are defined, implemented, and maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Standards governing NSC rulesets are defined and applied, covering how rules are created, reviewed, and approved before deployment.

requirements.name: All changes to network connections and to configurations of NSCs are approved and managed
requirements.requirement_text: Changes to network connections and NSC configurations go through the change control process before being applied.

requirements.name: An accurate network diagram is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: A current diagram shows all connections between the cardholder data environment and other networks, including wireless.

requirements.name: An accurate data-flow diagram is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: A current diagram documents all account data flows across systems and networks.

requirements.name: All services, protocols, and ports allowed are identified, approved, and have a defined business need
requirements.requirement_text: Every permitted service, protocol, and port is inventoried with a documented business justification.

requirements.name: Security features are defined and implemented for all services, protocols, and ports in use that are considered insecure
requirements.requirement_text: Insecure services in use have compensating security features defined and applied.

requirements.name: Configurations of NSCs are reviewed at least once every six months
requirements.requirement_text: NSC configurations are reviewed on a defined schedule to confirm they remain relevant and effective.

requirements.name: Configuration files for NSCs are secured from unauthorized access and kept consistent with active network configurations
requirements.requirement_text: NSC configuration files are protected and synchronized with the running configuration.

requirements.name: Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted to only that which is necessary
requirements.requirement_text: Inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment is limited to necessary traffic; all other traffic is denied.

requirements.name: Outbound traffic from the CDE is restricted to only that which is necessary
requirements.requirement_text: Outbound traffic from the cardholder data environment is limited to necessary traffic; all other traffic is denied.

requirements.name: NSCs are installed between all wireless networks and the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Network security controls sit between wireless networks and the CDE, denying or explicitly authorizing traffic.

requirements.name: NSCs are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks
requirements.requirement_text: Network security controls are deployed at every boundary between trusted and untrusted networks.

requirements.name: Inbound traffic from untrusted networks to trusted networks is restricted
requirements.requirement_text: Inbound traffic from untrusted networks is limited to authorized communications only.

requirements.name: Anti-spoofing measures are implemented to detect and block forged source IP addresses
requirements.requirement_text: Anti-spoofing controls prevent forged source IP addresses from entering the trusted network.

requirements.name: System components that store cardholder data are not directly accessible from untrusted networks
requirements.requirement_text: Stored cardholder data is not reachable directly from untrusted networks.

requirements.name: The disclosure of internal IP addresses and routing information is limited to only authorized parties
requirements.requirement_text: Internal addressing and routing information is not exposed to unauthorized parties.

requirements.name: Security controls are implemented on any computing devices that connect to both untrusted networks and the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Devices that can reach both untrusted networks and the CDE carry defined security controls and cannot be altered by the user.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for applying secure configurations are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 2 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 2 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for secure-configuration activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Configuration standards cover all system components, address known vulnerabilities, and are consistent with industry-accepted hardening benchmarks.

requirements.name: Vendor default accounts are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Vendor default accounts are removed or disabled; where retained, the default password is changed and use is justified.

requirements.name: Primary functions requiring different security levels are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Functions with differing security levels do not coexist on one component, or are isolated so they cannot affect each other.

requirements.name: Only necessary services, protocols, daemons, and functions are enabled
requirements.requirement_text: Unnecessary services and functions are removed, disabled, or otherwise prevented from running.

requirements.name: Where insecure services, protocols, or daemons are present, business justification and additional security features are documented
requirements.requirement_text: Any insecure service still in use is justified and has documented mitigating controls.

requirements.name: System security parameters are configured to prevent misuse
requirements.requirement_text: Security parameters are set to prevent misuse across all system components.

requirements.name: All non-console administrative access is encrypted using strong cryptography
requirements.requirement_text: Administrative access that does not use the physical console is encrypted in transit.

requirements.name: For wireless environments connected to the CDE, all wireless vendor defaults are changed at installation or confirmed secure
requirements.requirement_text: Wireless defaults including keys, passphrases, and SNMP strings are changed or verified secure.

requirements.name: Wireless encryption keys are changed when personnel with knowledge of the key leave or the key is suspected of compromise
requirements.requirement_text: Wireless keys are rotated on personnel change or suspected compromise.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 3 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 3 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for protecting stored account data are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Account data storage is kept to a minimum
requirements.requirement_text: Data retention and disposal policies limit stored account data to what is legally or operationally required, with defined retention periods and secure deletion.

requirements.name: Sensitive authentication data is not retained after authorization
requirements.requirement_text: Full track data, card verification codes, and PINs are not stored after authorization completes, even if encrypted.

requirements.name: Sensitive authentication data stored electronically prior to authorization is encrypted
requirements.requirement_text: Any SAD stored before authorization is encrypted using strong cryptography.

requirements.name: Additional requirements for issuers: any storage of sensitive authentication data is justified and secured
requirements.requirement_text: Issuers storing SAD have a documented business justification and secure the data with strong cryptography.

requirements.name: PAN is masked when displayed such that only personnel with a legitimate business need can see more than the BIN and last four digits
requirements.requirement_text: Displayed PANs are masked by default; fuller display requires a documented business need.

requirements.name: When using remote-access technologies, copying and relocation of PAN is prevented for personnel without documented authorization
requirements.requirement_text: Technical controls stop unauthorized copying of PAN during remote access sessions.

requirements.name: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored
requirements.requirement_text: Stored PAN is protected by one-way hashing, truncation, tokenization, or strong cryptography.

evidence_requirements.description: Storage encryption configuration showing PAN is rendered unreadable at rest.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Whether stored PAN is rendered unreadable is a boolean in a storage/encryption config export.
assessment_procedures: Examine the storage encryption configuration covering stored PAN.
Examine a sample of stored data and confirm PAN is not readable.

requirements.name: Procedures are defined and implemented to protect cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data
requirements.requirement_text: Key management procedures cover generation, distribution, storage, and access restriction for keys protecting stored account data.

requirements.name: Key-management policies and procedures are implemented to include generation of strong cryptographic keys
requirements.requirement_text: Strong keys are generated according to documented key-management procedures.

requirements.name: Key-management procedures include secure distribution of cryptographic keys
requirements.requirement_text: Keys are distributed securely per documented procedures.

requirements.name: Key-management procedures include secure storage of cryptographic keys
requirements.requirement_text: Keys are stored securely in the fewest possible locations.

requirements.name: Key-management procedures include cryptographic key changes at the end of the defined cryptoperiod
requirements.requirement_text: Keys are retired and replaced at the end of their defined cryptoperiod.

requirements.name: Key-management procedures include retirement or replacement of keys as deemed necessary
requirements.requirement_text: Keys are retired or replaced when integrity is weakened or compromise is suspected.

requirements.name: Where manual cleartext key-management operations are used, they are managed using split knowledge and dual control
requirements.requirement_text: Manual cleartext key operations require at least two people, each holding only part of the key.

requirements.name: Key-management procedures include prevention of unauthorized substitution of cryptographic keys
requirements.requirement_text: Controls prevent an attacker from substituting a key of their choosing.

requirements.name: Key custodians formally acknowledge that they understand and accept their responsibilities
requirements.requirement_text: Key custodians sign a formal acknowledgement of their key-custodian duties.

requirements.name: Additional requirements for service providers: keys shared with customers are documented and managed
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers document and manage keys shared with customers for transmission or storage of account data.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for protecting cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 4 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 4 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for protecting data in transit are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks
requirements.requirement_text: Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted, the protocol supports only secure versions, and the encryption strength is appropriate.

evidence_requirements.description: TLS/load-balancer configuration showing the minimum protocol version accepted.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Minimum negotiated TLS version is a single enumerated string in a TLS/proxy config.
assessment_procedures: Examine the TLS/load-balancer configuration for the minimum protocol version accepted.
Test the endpoint and confirm connections below the minimum version are refused.

requirements.name: PAN is secured with strong cryptography whenever it is sent via end-user messaging technologies
requirements.requirement_text: PAN sent by email, chat, SMS, or similar channels is rendered unreadable or protected with strong cryptography.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for protecting systems from malicious software are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 5 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 5 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for anti-malware activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: An anti-malware solution is deployed on all system components, except those determined not to be at risk
requirements.requirement_text: Anti-malware is deployed wherever malware is a risk, with exclusions justified by periodic evaluation.

requirements.name: The deployed anti-malware solution detects all known types of malware and removes, blocks, or contains them
requirements.requirement_text: The anti-malware solution addresses all known malware types.

requirements.name: Any system components not protected by anti-malware are evaluated periodically
requirements.requirement_text: Components excluded from anti-malware coverage are re-evaluated on a defined frequency.

requirements.name: The anti-malware solution is kept current via automatic updates
requirements.requirement_text: Anti-malware definitions and engines update automatically.

requirements.name: The anti-malware solution performs periodic scans and active or real-time scans
requirements.requirement_text: Scanning runs continuously, behaviourally, or on a defined periodic schedule.

requirements.name: For removable electronic media, the anti-malware solution scans when media is inserted or performs continuous behavioural analysis
requirements.requirement_text: Removable media is scanned on insertion or covered by continuous behavioural analysis.

requirements.name: Audit logs for the anti-malware solution are enabled and retained
requirements.requirement_text: Anti-malware logs are enabled and retained per the log retention requirement.

requirements.name: Anti-malware mechanisms cannot be disabled or altered by users unless specifically documented and authorized
requirements.requirement_text: Users cannot disable anti-malware; exceptions are time-limited and management-authorized.

requirements.name: Processes and automated mechanisms are in place to detect and protect personnel against phishing attacks
requirements.requirement_text: Anti-phishing controls detect and protect personnel from phishing attempts.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for developing and maintaining secure systems and software are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 6 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 6 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for secure development and maintenance are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Bespoke and custom software is developed securely
requirements.requirement_text: Software is developed based on industry standards and secure design, with information security considered at every stage of the SDLC.

requirements.name: Software development personnel are trained at least annually in secure software design and secure coding
requirements.requirement_text: Developers receive annual training relevant to their role and the languages they use.

requirements.name: Bespoke and custom software is reviewed prior to release to production to identify and correct potential coding vulnerabilities
requirements.requirement_text: Code review by someone other than the author, covering secure coding practice, occurs before release.

requirements.name: Software engineering techniques are used to prevent or mitigate common software attacks
requirements.requirement_text: Injection, cryptographic, business logic, and access control attacks are addressed by engineering technique.

requirements.name: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed
requirements.requirement_text: New vulnerabilities are identified from recognized sources, assigned a risk ranking, and tracked.

requirements.name: An inventory of bespoke and custom software and third-party components is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: An inventory of software components, including third-party libraries, supports vulnerability management.

requirements.name: All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches
requirements.requirement_text: Critical and high-severity patches are installed within one month of release; others within an appropriate timeframe.

requirements.name: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks
requirements.requirement_text: Public-facing web applications are reviewed by vulnerability assessment or protected by an automated technical solution.

requirements.name: An automated technical solution is deployed for public-facing web applications that continually detects and prevents web-based attacks
requirements.requirement_text: A WAF or equivalent runs continuously in front of public-facing web applications.

requirements.name: All payment page scripts loaded and executed in the consumer browser are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Each payment page script is authorized, its integrity assured, and an inventory with written justification maintained.

requirements.name: Changes to all system components in the production environment are made according to established procedures
requirements.requirement_text: Changes follow documented procedures covering reason, documented approval, and functionality testing.

requirements.name: Upon completion of a significant change, all applicable PCI DSS requirements are confirmed to be in place
requirements.requirement_text: Applicable requirements are re-verified after a significant change and documentation updated.

requirements.name: Pre-production environments are separated from production environments
requirements.requirement_text: Separation between pre-production and production is enforced with access controls.

requirements.name: Roles and functions are separated between production and pre-production environments
requirements.requirement_text: Duties are separated so that one person cannot move a change to production unchecked.

requirements.name: Live PANs are not used in pre-production environments, except where those environments are in the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Test environments do not contain live PAN unless included in the CDE and protected accordingly.

requirements.name: Test data and test accounts are removed from system components before the system goes into production
requirements.requirement_text: Test accounts and data are removed prior to production release.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for restricting access by business need to know are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 7 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 7 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for access restriction activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: An access control model is defined and includes granting access as appropriate based on business need
requirements.requirement_text: The access model covers needed access per role, privilege level, and least privilege.

requirements.name: Access is assigned to users based on job classification and function, and least privileges required
requirements.requirement_text: Users receive the least privilege needed for their job function.

requirements.name: Required privileges are approved by authorized personnel
requirements.requirement_text: Privilege assignments carry documented approval from authorized personnel.

requirements.name: All user accounts and related access privileges are reviewed at least once every six months
requirements.requirement_text: Account and privilege reviews confirm access remains appropriate and inappropriate access is addressed.

requirements.name: All application and system accounts and related access privileges are assigned and managed
requirements.requirement_text: Application and system accounts run with least privilege for their function.

requirements.name: All user access to query repositories of stored cardholder data is restricted
requirements.requirement_text: Query access to stored cardholder data is limited to programmatic methods and to authorized administrators.

requirements.name: An access control system is in place that restricts access based on a user's need to know
requirements.requirement_text: An access control system covers all system components.

requirements.name: The access control system is configured to enforce permissions assigned to individuals, applications, and systems based on job classification and function
requirements.requirement_text: Permissions are enforced per assigned role.

requirements.name: The access control system is set to deny all by default
requirements.requirement_text: Default deny is the configured behaviour of the access control system.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for identifying users and authenticating access are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 8 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 8 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for identification and authentication activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: All users are assigned a unique ID before access to system components or cardholder data is allowed
requirements.requirement_text: Every user has a unique identifier; shared IDs are not used for access.

requirements.name: Group, shared, or generic accounts are only used when necessary on an exception basis
requirements.requirement_text: Shared accounts are exceptional, documented, justified, and their use is attributable to an individual.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: customer remote access accounts use unique authentication factors per customer
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers use a distinct authentication credential for each customer premises they access.

requirements.name: Addition, deletion, and modification of user IDs, authentication factors, and other identifier objects are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Identity lifecycle changes are authorized with appropriate approval.

requirements.name: Access for terminated users is immediately revoked
requirements.requirement_text: Terminated users lose access immediately.

requirements.name: Inactive user accounts are removed or disabled within 90 days of inactivity
requirements.requirement_text: Accounts inactive for 90 days are disabled or removed.

requirements.name: Accounts used by third parties are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Third-party accounts are enabled only during the period needed, monitored while in use, and disabled after.

requirements.name: If a user session has been idle for more than 15 minutes, the user is required to re-authenticate
requirements.requirement_text: Idle sessions require re-authentication after 15 minutes.

evidence_requirements.description: Session configuration export showing the idle timeout before re-authentication.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Idle re-authentication timeout is a single integer in minutes; the standard caps it at 15.
assessment_procedures: Examine session configuration for the idle timeout before re-authentication is required.
Observe an idle session and confirm re-authentication is demanded.

requirements.name: All user access is authenticated via at least one authentication factor
requirements.requirement_text: Access requires at least one of: something you know, have, or are.

requirements.name: Strong cryptography is used to render all authentication factors unreadable during transmission and storage
requirements.requirement_text: Authentication factors are protected by strong cryptography in transit and at rest.

requirements.name: User identity is verified before modifying any authentication factor
requirements.requirement_text: Identity is verified before a credential is changed or reset.

requirements.name: Invalid authentication attempts are limited by locking out the user ID after not more than 10 attempts
requirements.requirement_text: Accounts lock after at most 10 invalid attempts, for at least 30 minutes or until identity is confirmed.

evidence_requirements.description: Authentication policy export showing the invalid-attempt lockout threshold.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Lockout threshold is a single integer; the standard caps it at 10 attempts.
assessment_procedures: Examine the authentication policy configuration for the invalid-attempt lockout threshold.
Observe a lockout being triggered after the configured number of failed attempts.

requirements.name: If passwords are used as authentication factors, they are set and reset securely for each user
requirements.requirement_text: Initial and reset passwords are unique per user and changed immediately after first use.

requirements.name: If passwords are used as authentication factors, they meet the minimum level of complexity
requirements.requirement_text: Passwords are at least 12 characters and contain both numeric and alphabetic characters.

evidence_requirements.description: Password policy export showing the configured minimum password length.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Minimum password length is a single integer in an IAM/password-policy export.
assessment_procedures: Examine the identity platform's password policy configuration and confirm the minimum length setting.
Observe an attempt to set a shorter password and confirm it is refused.

requirements.name: Individuals are not allowed to submit a new password that is the same as any of the last four passwords used
requirements.requirement_text: Password history prevents reuse of the previous four passwords.

evidence_requirements.description: Password policy export showing how many previous passwords are remembered.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Password history depth is a single integer; the standard requires the last four.
assessment_procedures: Examine the password policy configuration for the number of previous passwords retained.
Observe an attempt to reuse a recent password and confirm it is refused.

requirements.name: Authentication policies and procedures are documented and communicated to all users
requirements.requirement_text: Users receive guidance on selecting strong credentials and protecting them.

requirements.name: If passwords are the only authentication factor, they are changed at least every 90 days or access is dynamically analyzed
requirements.requirement_text: Single-factor password access requires 90-day rotation or dynamic risk analysis.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: guidance is provided to customers about changing passwords
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers give customers password guidance where passwords are the only factor for customer access.

requirements.name: Where authentication factors such as tokens or smart cards are used, they are assigned to an individual user
requirements.requirement_text: Hardware and software tokens are individually assigned, not shared.

requirements.name: MFA is implemented for all non-console access into the CDE for personnel with administrative access
requirements.requirement_text: Administrative non-console access to the CDE requires multi-factor authentication.

requirements.name: MFA is implemented for all non-console access into the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: All non-console CDE access requires multi-factor authentication.

evidence_requirements.description: Identity provider export showing MFA enforcement for all non-console CDE access.

requirements.deterministic_justification: MFA for non-console CDE access is a boolean in an identity-provider export.
assessment_procedures: Examine the identity provider configuration for MFA enforcement on non-console CDE access.
Observe a non-console login into the CDE and confirm a second factor is required.

requirements.name: MFA is implemented for all remote network access originating from outside the entity's network that could access the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Remote access from outside the network requires multi-factor authentication.

requirements.name: MFA systems are implemented appropriately
requirements.requirement_text: MFA is not susceptible to replay, cannot be bypassed without documented exception, uses at least two distinct factor types, and requires all factors to succeed.

requirements.name: Accounts used by systems or applications that can be used for interactive login are managed
requirements.requirement_text: Interactive use of system accounts is prevented, or permitted only exceptionally with individual attribution.

requirements.name: Passwords for application and system accounts used for interactive login are not hard coded in scripts or files
requirements.requirement_text: Credentials for interactive system accounts are not embedded in source, scripts, or configuration files.

requirements.name: Passwords for application and system accounts are protected against misuse
requirements.requirement_text: Such passwords are rotated periodically and have complexity appropriate to the rotation frequency.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 9 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 9 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for physical access activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Appropriate facility entry controls are in place to restrict physical access to systems in the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Entry controls restrict physical access to CDE facilities.

requirements.name: Physical and/or logical controls are implemented to restrict use of publicly accessible network jacks
requirements.requirement_text: Publicly accessible network jacks are restricted.

requirements.name: Physical access to wireless access points, gateways, networking hardware, and telecommunication lines is restricted
requirements.requirement_text: Network hardware and lines are physically protected.

requirements.name: Access to consoles in sensitive areas is restricted via locking when not in use
requirements.requirement_text: Consoles in sensitive areas are locked when unattended.

requirements.name: Procedures are implemented for authorizing and managing physical access of personnel to the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Personnel access to the CDE is authorized, identified, and revoked on termination.

requirements.name: Procedures are implemented for authorizing and managing visitor access to the CDE
requirements.requirement_text: Visitors are authorized, escorted, and identifiable.

requirements.name: Visitor badges or identification are surrendered or deactivated before visitors leave
requirements.requirement_text: Visitor identification is collected or deactivated on departure.

requirements.name: A visitor log is used to maintain a physical record of visitor activity
requirements.requirement_text: A visitor log records name, organization, and authorizing person, and is retained for at least three months.

requirements.name: All media with cardholder data is physically secured
requirements.requirement_text: Media containing cardholder data is stored securely.

requirements.name: All media with cardholder data is classified in accordance with the sensitivity of the data
requirements.requirement_text: Media is classified according to data sensitivity.

requirements.name: Media with cardholder data sent outside the facility is secured
requirements.requirement_text: Media sent outside is sent by secured courier with tracking.

requirements.name: Management approves all media with cardholder data that is moved outside the facility
requirements.requirement_text: Management approval precedes movement of media outside the facility.

requirements.name: Inventory logs of all electronic media with cardholder data are maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Electronic media inventory logs are maintained and reconciled at least annually.

requirements.name: Hard-copy materials with cardholder data are destroyed when no longer needed
requirements.requirement_text: Hard copy is cross-cut shredded, incinerated, or pulped beyond reconstruction.

requirements.name: Electronic media with cardholder data is destroyed when no longer needed
requirements.requirement_text: Electronic media is destroyed or rendered irrecoverable.

requirements.name: POI devices that capture payment card data via direct physical interaction are protected from tampering and unauthorized substitution
requirements.requirement_text: POI devices are inventoried, periodically inspected, and personnel trained to detect tampering.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring all access are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 10 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 10 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for logging and monitoring activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data
requirements.requirement_text: Audit logging is enabled across all system components.

requirements.name: Audit logs record specified details for each auditable event
requirements.requirement_text: Each log entry records user, event type, date and time, success or failure, origin, and affected data or resource.

requirements.name: Read access to audit log files is limited to those with a job-related need
requirements.requirement_text: Audit log read access is restricted by job need.

requirements.name: Audit log files are protected to prevent modifications by individuals
requirements.requirement_text: Logs are protected from modification.

requirements.name: Audit log files, including those for external-facing technologies, are promptly backed up to a secure, central, internal log server
requirements.requirement_text: Logs are backed up promptly to a secure central location.

requirements.name: File integrity monitoring or change-detection mechanisms are used on audit logs
requirements.requirement_text: Change detection alerts on modification of existing log data.

requirements.name: Audit logs for specified system components are reviewed at least once daily
requirements.requirement_text: Daily review covers security events, CDE components, and critical security control systems.

requirements.name: Logs of all other system components are reviewed periodically
requirements.requirement_text: Non-critical component logs are reviewed on a risk-defined frequency.

requirements.name: Exceptions and anomalies identified during the review process are addressed
requirements.requirement_text: Identified anomalies are investigated and resolved.

requirements.name: Retain audit log history for at least 12 months, with at least the most recent three months immediately available
requirements.requirement_text: Twelve months of log history is retained, three months immediately available for analysis.

evidence_requirements.description: Log management configuration showing the audit log retention period in months.

requirements.deterministic_justification: Audit log retention is a single integer in months; the standard requires at least 12.
assessment_procedures: Examine the log management configuration for the retention period.
Examine stored logs and confirm at least twelve months are retained and three are immediately available.

requirements.name: System clocks and time are synchronized using time-synchronization technology
requirements.requirement_text: Time synchronization technology is in use across systems.

requirements.name: Systems are configured to the correct and consistent time
requirements.requirement_text: Time settings derive from accepted external sources and are consistent.

requirements.name: Time synchronization settings and data are protected
requirements.requirement_text: Time data access is restricted and changes are logged and reviewed.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: failures of critical security control systems are detected, alerted, and addressed promptly
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers detect and respond to failures of critical security controls.

requirements.name: Failures of critical security control systems are detected, alerted, and addressed promptly
requirements.requirement_text: Failures of controls such as NSCs, anti-malware, logging, and monitoring are detected and responded to.

requirements.name: Failures of any critical security controls systems are responded to promptly
requirements.requirement_text: Response includes restoring function, identifying cause, and addressing any resulting security issues.

requirements.name: Processes and mechanisms for regularly testing security of systems and networks are defined and understood
requirements.requirement_text: Security policies and operational procedures for Requirement 11 are documented, current, in use, and known to affected parties.

requirements.name: Roles and responsibilities for Requirement 11 activities are documented and assigned
requirements.requirement_text: Roles for security testing activities are documented, assigned, and understood.

requirements.name: Authorized and unauthorized wireless access points are managed and a list is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Wireless access points are detected and inventoried on a defined frequency.

requirements.name: An inventory of authorized wireless access points is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Authorized wireless access points are inventoried with documented business justification.

requirements.name: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months
requirements.requirement_text: Internal scans run quarterly, with high-risk and critical vulnerabilities resolved and rescans performed.

requirements.name: External vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months by an ASV
requirements.requirement_text: Quarterly external scans by an Approved Scanning Vendor are passed, with rescans as needed.

requirements.name: A penetration testing methodology is defined, documented, and implemented
requirements.requirement_text: The methodology covers industry-accepted approaches, scope, testing types, retention, and retesting.

requirements.name: Internal penetration testing is performed at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Annual internal penetration testing is performed by a qualified, organizationally independent tester.

requirements.name: External penetration testing is performed at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Annual external penetration testing is performed by a qualified, organizationally independent tester.

requirements.name: Exploitable vulnerabilities and security weaknesses found during penetration testing are corrected
requirements.requirement_text: Findings are corrected per risk ranking and retested to verify correction.

requirements.name: If segmentation is used, penetration tests are performed on segmentation controls at least every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Segmentation controls are penetration tested annually to confirm isolation of the CDE.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: segmentation controls are penetration tested at least every six months
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers test segmentation controls every six months and after any change.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for multi-tenant service providers: external penetration testing support is provided to customers
requirements.requirement_text: Multi-tenant service providers support customer external penetration testing.

requirements.name: Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network
requirements.requirement_text: IDS/IPS monitors traffic at the CDE perimeter and critical points, alerting on suspected compromise.

requirements.name: A change-detection mechanism is deployed to alert personnel to unauthorized modification of critical files
requirements.requirement_text: File integrity monitoring alerts on unauthorized change to critical system, configuration, or content files.

requirements.name: A change- and tamper-detection mechanism is deployed for payment pages
requirements.requirement_text: Alerts fire on unauthorized modification to HTTP headers and payment page content, evaluated at least weekly.

requirements.name: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated
requirements.requirement_text: A security policy exists, is reviewed at least annually, and is communicated to all relevant personnel.

requirements.name: The information security policy is reviewed at least once every 12 months and updated as needed
requirements.requirement_text: Annual policy review reflects changes to business objectives and risk.

requirements.name: The security policy clearly defines information security roles and responsibilities
requirements.requirement_text: Roles and responsibilities are defined and formally acknowledged by personnel.

requirements.name: Responsibility for information security is formally assigned to a Chief Information Security Officer or knowledgeable executive
requirements.requirement_text: Executive accountability for information security is formally assigned.

requirements.name: Acceptable use policies for end-user technologies are documented and implemented
requirements.requirement_text: Acceptable use policies cover approval, authentication, inventory, and acceptable uses of end-user technologies.

requirements.name: Each PCI DSS requirement providing flexibility for how frequently it is performed is supported by a targeted risk analysis
requirements.requirement_text: Targeted risk analyses justify the chosen frequency for flexible requirements and are reviewed annually.

requirements.name: A targeted risk analysis is performed for each PCI DSS requirement met with the customized approach
requirements.requirement_text: Customized approach implementations are supported by a documented targeted risk analysis.

requirements.name: Cryptographic cipher suites and protocols in use are documented and reviewed at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: An inventory of cipher suites and protocols is maintained and reviewed annually for continued viability.

requirements.name: Hardware and software technologies in use are reviewed at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Annual technology review covers end-of-life status, vendor support, and remediation plans.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: responsibility is established for protecting cardholder data and a PCI DSS compliance program
requirements.requirement_text: Service provider executive management establishes accountability for the compliance program.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: reviews are performed at least once every three months to confirm personnel are performing security tasks
requirements.requirement_text: Quarterly reviews confirm security tasks are being performed as documented.

requirements.name: An inventory of system components in scope for PCI DSS is maintained and kept current
requirements.requirement_text: A current inventory of in-scope system components with descriptions is maintained.

requirements.name: PCI DSS scope is documented and confirmed at least once every 12 months and upon significant change
requirements.requirement_text: Annual scope confirmation identifies all data flows, locations, and connected system components.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: significant organizational change results in documented review of PCI DSS scope
requirements.requirement_text: Organizational change triggers a documented scope review reported to executive management.

requirements.name: A formal security awareness program is implemented to make personnel aware of the information security policy
requirements.requirement_text: A security awareness program covers the security policy and personnel role in protecting account data.

requirements.name: The security awareness program is reviewed at least once every 12 months and updated as needed
requirements.requirement_text: Annual review addresses new threats and vulnerabilities.

requirements.name: Personnel receive security awareness training upon hire and at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Training occurs on hire and annually, with personnel acknowledging they understand the policy.

requirements.name: Potential personnel who will have access to the CDE are screened prior to hire
requirements.requirement_text: Pre-hire screening reduces insider-threat risk for CDE access.

requirements.name: A list of all third-party service providers with which account data is shared is maintained
requirements.requirement_text: A TPSP list records each provider and a description of the service.

requirements.name: Written agreements with TPSPs are maintained
requirements.requirement_text: Agreements acknowledge TPSP responsibility for the security of account data they possess or can affect.

requirements.name: An established process is implemented for engaging TPSPs, including proper due diligence prior to engagement
requirements.requirement_text: Due diligence precedes TPSP engagement.

requirements.name: A program is implemented to monitor TPSPs' PCI DSS compliance status at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: TPSP compliance status is monitored annually.

requirements.name: Information is maintained about which PCI DSS requirements are managed by each TPSP, by the entity, or shared
requirements.requirement_text: A responsibility matrix records the split of requirement ownership.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: written acknowledgements are provided to customers
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers acknowledge in writing their responsibility for account data security.

requirements.name: Additional requirement for service providers: information about PCI DSS compliance status is supported for customers
requirements.requirement_text: Service providers supply compliance information on customer request.

requirements.name: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated in the event of a suspected or confirmed security incident
requirements.requirement_text: The plan covers roles, communication, containment, legal requirements, coverage of all critical components, and reference to brand procedures.

evidence_requirements.description: Incident response plan showing its named owner and approval date.

assessment_procedures: Examine the incident response plan and confirm it names an owner and an approval date.
Interview responsible personnel to confirm the plan is known and ready to activate.

requirements.name: The security incident response plan is reviewed and tested at least once every 12 months
requirements.requirement_text: Annual review and testing covers all plan elements.

requirements.name: Specific personnel are designated to be available on a 24/7 basis to respond to security incidents
requirements.requirement_text: 24/7 incident response availability is designated.

requirements.name: Personnel responsible for responding to security incidents are appropriately and periodically trained
requirements.requirement_text: Incident responders are periodically trained on breach and incident response.

requirements.name: The security incident response plan includes monitoring and responding to alerts from security monitoring systems
requirements.requirement_text: The plan covers alerts from IDS/IPS, change detection, and payment page tamper detection.

requirements.name: The security incident response plan is modified and evolved according to lessons learned and industry developments
requirements.requirement_text: Lessons learned feed back into the plan.

requirements.name: Incident response procedures are in place, to be initiated upon the detection of stored PAN anywhere it is not expected
requirements.requirement_text: Unexpected stored PAN triggers a defined response including determining source and remediating leakage.

authoring_note: evaluation_mode, facts, rules, applicability_conditions and assessment_procedures are human-authored and reviewed as code. 01_REQUIREMENTS.md forbids an LLM populating them under any circumstance. applicability_conditions are AND-combined; an empty list means the control applies universally. EXISTS/NOT_EXISTS are rejected in conditions because they cannot express UNDETERMINED and would let an unanswered profile question silently exclude a control.
